hints.title: Battleship Head Identification
hints.text: Every horizontal or vertical ship has a unique top-left leading cell.

hints.title: Adjacent Neighbor Independence
hints.text: Since ships cannot be adjacent, any X that has no X directly above it and no X directly to its left must be the start of a ship.

hints.title: Single Pass Constant Space Scan
hints.text: Iterate across all cells from top to bottom and left to right. When cell is X, check if row is greater than zero and upper cell is X, or col is greater than zero and left cell is X. If neither condition holds, increment battleship count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass counting top-left cell of each ship without modifying matrix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph traversal (DFS) modifies board or requires an O(M * N) visited matrix.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting only top-left ship heads allows O(1) space with zero mutation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Count battleship heads in a single pass without modifying the input array.
